contract.title: Contract
contract.description: A recurring or one-off contract between the organization and a client. Drives MRR/ARR, renewal-window detection, renewal-lead automation and churn metrics. References an existing client object (identity is never duplicated). Field names contractNumber/startDate/endDate/value/status are read by the customer-portal contract reader without mapping.

activate.description: Activate a draft contract (or pull an expiring one back to active after a renewal).

backToDraft.description: Return a contract to draft for correction.

enterRenewalWindow.description: Renewal engine marks the contract as approaching its end date (engine-only; ContractService also requires byEngine).

renew.description: Close the contract as renewed (ContractService also requires a won renewal lead). Terminal.

churn.description: Close the contract as churned (lost on renewal). Terminal.

cancel.description: Cancel the contract (ContractService also requires a cancellationReason). Terminal.

message.nl: Het contract {{contractNumber}} ({{title}}) nadert het einde van de looptijd. Beoordeel de verlenging.
message.en: Contract {{contractNumber}} ({{title}}) is approaching its end date. Review the renewal.

contractNumber.description: Auto-generated unique contract number (C-{year}-{seq}). Read by customer-portal.

clientRef.description: UUID reference to the existing client object. Client identity is never duplicated into the contract.

lineItems.description: Contract line items referencing the existing product/service catalog.

productRef.description: UUID reference to a product/service in the catalog.

billingInterval.description: Billing cadence used to normalize MRR.

valuePerInterval.description: Recurring value per billing interval in the contract currency.

value.description: Alias of valuePerInterval for the customer-portal contract reader (kept in sync on save).

endDate.description: Contract end date. Recommended even for indefinite contracts so the renewal engine can act.

autoRenew.description: Whether the contract renews automatically unless cancelled by the notice deadline.

noticePeriodDays.description: Notice period in days before endDate; widens the renewal window.

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'expiring' is set only by the renewal engine; terminal states reject further transitions.

ownerId.description: Owning account-manager user ID; defaults to the client's owner.

renewalLeadRef.description: UUID of the renewal lead created when the contract enters its renewal window.

predecessorContractRef.description: UUID of the contract this one succeeds (set on a drafted successor).

renewalLeadOutcome.description: Reconciliation marker for the renewal lead: 'won' or 'lost'.

noticeReminderSent.description: Idempotency marker: the notice-deadline My Work entry has been created.
